description: Image Description: The image features a decorative arrangement of citrus plants, likely kumquat trees, adorned with bright orange fruits. The envelopes have ornate gold designs and Chinese characters on them, contributing to the festive appearance. The background is slightly blurred, indicating an indoor or outdoor setting with large windows or glass panels, suggesting a celebratory or ornamental display.
